prompt:
The folder docs/ holds a glossary, 00-glossary.md, and 36 documents, 01.md to 36.md. The documents refer to internal codes written as [[CODE]], for example [[AB1]], and the glossary says what each code means.

Read the glossary first. Then go through the documents one at a time, in order: read one document, edit it, and only then read the next. Do not write a script or a loop that edits several documents; handle every document yourself.

In each document, replace every [[CODE]] reference with the meaning of that code from the glossary, wrapped in single asterisks. For example, if the glossary says "AB1: the front desk", then [[AB1]] becomes *the front desk*. Change nothing else in the documents, and do not change the glossary. When all 36 documents are done, reply with the number of references you replaced.
